select s.relname,
 (io.heap_blks_read+coalesce(io.idx_blks_read,0)+coalesce(io.toast_blks_read,0))*8/1024 as disk_read_mb,
 (io.heap_blks_hit+coalesce(io.idx_blks_hit,0)+coalesce(io.toast_blks_hit,0))*8/1024/1024 as cache_hit_gb,
 s.n_tup_upd as upd, s.n_tup_hot_upd as hot_upd, s.n_live_tup as live, s.n_dead_tup as dead,
 to_char(s.last_autovacuum,'MM-DD HH24:MI') as last_av, s.autovacuum_count as av_n
from pg_stat_user_tables s join pg_statio_user_tables io using (relid)
order by disk_read_mb desc limit 25
